items.title: PayPal Stock Gains After Beat-And-Raise — Why Wall Street Isn’t Chasing Buyout Hopes Like Retail
items.summary: Analysts remain focused on PayPal’s turnaround strategy, while Stocktwits retail traders debate whether the company could command a much higher takeover price.

items.title: PayPal CEO signals deal openness but sticks with standalone strategy
items.summary: Stripe and Advent International jointly recently bid $60.50 per share for PayPal, according to media reports. PayPal's board, with advice from Goldman Sachs and Evercore, signaled that the offer price was too low. With PYPL trading at $58.47 as of Tuesday afternoon, investors appear to be pricing in either a sweetened offer or a credible standalone recovery.
